note: ERA 6. T2 (A65, A66, A79): rail is a network of its own, a railStation is a GATE, and worldgen places rock and marsh. A live gate - a station whose line reaches a map edge, powered and with road access - adds gate.rail's integer terms to the regional demand pool, seeds the commuter field as a sink and takes gate.rail.farePerResident from every resident within gate.rail.range. build.rail and upkeep.rail are the line's. ERA 5. T1a (A60): a second road kind. An avenue carries traffic.avenueCapacity times a road before it reads as full, and the commuter field crosses it at traffic.avenueStep against a road traffic.roadStep - so a grid with one avenue routes onto it. build.avenue is its price. ERA 4. B1a (A62): a fire nobody fights spreads and burns slowly rather than dying with the house it started in (fire.unfoughtPercent, unfoughtSpread, unfoughtDamage), and the deputy builds a fire station per deputy.buildingsPerStation buildings - until now it built none, and no gate city in the project has ever had a fire service. Era 3: B9 (A81): the deputy lays a road only within deputy.roadReach tiles of a lot that is built, or zoned and supplied, so a played town grows outward and has an edge; see reports/balance-era3.md. Era 2 is left to T1/T2's re-pin (A79). Otherwise unchanged from era 1 — ERA 1. Tuned 2026-08-29 against tools/sim_sweep.mjs over 200 games per configuration; see reports/balance-era1.md. Changed from era 0: civic.pollutionAverage now averages over developed land instead of the whole region, so it reads 9 instead of 0 and can drive something. RE-TESTED AND REJECTED, for the second time: per-tile wire and pipe upkeep. At 1 each it put p25 treasury on 0 and cut p25 population from 647 to 187 — it bankrupts weak cities without touching the rich ones, which is what the era-0 note already said. ACCEPTED, not fixed: runaway treasuries, median 1.9M and p95 3.8M after 25 years. Numbers from era 0 are void, not roughly comparable.

gate._comment: T2 (A65): the Outside is gate buildings, not a second simulation. A LIVE gate adds these integer terms to the regional demand pool, seeds the commuter field as a sink, and takes a fare from every resident within range. ERA 0, UNTUNED against the bases in `demand` below (400/150/150).

fire._unfought: B1a (A62): a fire is unaddressed when at least unfoughtPercent of the building's own fire risk is left after coverage - no station in range - and it then spreads unfoughtSpread times as readily while consuming its house more slowly, so it outlives what it is standing on and reaches the next one.

disasters._comment: era 0, untuned. Frequency is difficulty.disasterOneIn, which already existed; this is only the shape of one.

traffic._comment: era 0, untuned. roadCapacity is load units per tile before a street reads as full.

deputy._comment: A81 (B9): the deputy lays a road only within roadReach tiles of a lot that is built, or zoned and supplied; expand reaches a little further than the doctrines that hold back. Era 3. T2: railAtPopulation is the size at which it lays a line to the edge and puts a station on it - just above avenueAtPopulation, so the order is the main road first and the railway after it.
